results.rationale: Consistency: The neutral tabletop and backdrop remain, but the flat silver-edged power bank becomes a thick rounded white block, and the phone loses its home button and changes bezel details; connector placement also changes. Requested phone relocation is excluded. Instruction: The side-by-side devices become a stack; the expected phone resting on top of the power bank is clearly present, fully satisfying the requested spatial relation. Quality: Object silhouettes, surface textures and shadows are coherent, but the conspicuous foreground cable appears to connect two sockets of the power bank itself while the phone has no visible connection, a clear semantic flaw.

Consistency: Vegetation replacement, added understory and obscured ground are allowed by the requested dense rainforest. The general sunlit woodland setting remains, but the visible sun moves substantially upward in the composition, a clear non-requested change. Instruction: Sparse straight-trunk woodland becomes dense broadleaf vegetation with overlapping upper crowns, palms, lower shrubs and hanging vines. This matches the expected multilayer tropical canopy completely. Knowledge: The supplied explanation calls for tall emergent trees, understory shrubs and intertwining vines; visible tall background trees, dense lower foliage and hanging vine strands provide these layers plausibly. Quality: Structure, lighting and foliage textures are generally coherent, with convincing filtered rays; some rounded canopy masses have slightly repetitive, sponge-like leaf texture, a minor imperfection.
